acceptance: Live Velox local-mode TPC-H SF0.01 tuned run with a spark.gluten.* key: ledger shows it executed and the effective-session-config block shows it applied
Live Velox remote (Spark Connect) run: snapshot status and any refused keys recorded correctly
context: Follow-up to #3077 (d9e9da9f4) and #3079 (e995879f3), 2026-10-17; no Gluten build was available on the macOS host.
description: #3079 made Velox apply a tuning file's spark map through apply_tuned_spark_session_config (benchbox/platforms/velox.py configure_for_benchmark), and #3077 added effective-session-config snapshots for Spark, LakeSail and Velox (benchbox/platforms/spark_effective_config.py). Both were verified only with fake sessions for Velox; only native Spark (PySpark 4.2, JDK 17) ran live. Still open: whether `spark.gluten.*` keys set at runtime read back as set; whether remote Velox over Spark Connect refuses core keys server-side and how that is recorded; and whether `spark.conf.getAll` works over Spark Connect, or the snapshot reports not_readable.
